description.value: McDonald's at 1055 West Georgia Street is a fast food restaurant in downtown Vancouver, situated inside a mixed-use building near the West End and steps from the central business district. The restaurant offers a broad menu spanning burgers, chicken, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages, with indoor seating and vegetarian options available. Its downtown core location makes it a practical food and beverage stop for cyclists transiting through Vancouver.
